You may prefer some other job, and maybe at different times different jobs seem more glamorous or more prestigious. But as we said at the beginning of this answer, we are all Hashem’s children. As children, all are beloved in the eyes of Hashem. And you will be judged on your mission and on how well you did your job — not how well you did someone else’s!I hope that made sense and helped.
